summary: Kaniksu NF knob with a 1933 crow's nest, abandoned in the 1940s and still there in the 1980s. The Forest Lookouts index marks it Removed, undated.

facts.status_note: Abandoned in the 1940s and still there in the 1980s (Willhite). Listed Removed on one index: a one-word status with no date or explanation. No source says what remains.

evidence.supports: crow's nest in 1933; still there 1980s; abandoned 1940s

evidence.quote: In 1933 there was a crow's nest.

evidence.supports: an early road crossed the west flank and went over Pyramid Pass, just north of the knob
evidence.quote: One of the earliest roads crossed the west side of the mountain, then crossing over Pyramid Pass just to the north of Grouse Knob.
In the 1940s, this site was abandoned.

evidence.supports: crow's nest still there in the 1980s
evidence.quote: In the 1980s it was still there.

evidence.supports: index gives a one-word status, Removed, with no date or explanation
Forest Fire Lookout Association types it a crow's nest and marks it abandoned
evidence.quote: Grouse Knob Pend Oreille 48.50421 -117.11678 Crowsnest Abandoned

evidence.supports: abandoned road runs nearly to the top, then old skid trails continue onto the summit plateau
evidence.quote: There is an abandoned road that climbs nearly to the summit, then old skid logging trails that reach up to the summit plateau.

evidence.supports: recommends a vehicle with some ground clearance
evidence.quote: Some clearance on vehicles is best

evidence.supports: route clear of brush in 2023, will not stay that way
evidence.quote: In 2023, this route was brush free but will not be forever.
The actual summit has remained untouched

corrections.why: The Forest Fire Lookout Association list types this site as Crowsnest, and firelookout.com and Willhite both describe a crow's nest.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Willhite says the crow's nest was still there in the 1980s; the Forest Lookouts index marks the site Removed with no date. Both fit if the removal came after the 1980s, but no source dates it.

notes_for_editor: The status Removed on the Forest Lookouts index is one undated word, and the FFLA list says Abandoned; neither gives a removal date. The record's gone status rests on Removed. Do not confuse with Grouse Mountain in Idaho (idaholookouts.weebly.com, Kaniksu NF 59N-1E-1), a different lookout. Access: Willhite's hiking note describes the route in 2023; no source says whether the summit is open to the public, so no access level is recorded. The record's kind platform is corrected to crowsnest. No photos recorded.
